in_arabic.name: راكان
in_arabic.meaning: راكان يعني القوي الشديد في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: راكان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه القوي الشديد، وقد ورد في اللغة العربية على أنه اسم للمفروض القوي في شدته، ومن معانيه أيضًا العظيم والضخم، ويوحي بالسكون والاستقرار في الكثير من الأحيان، وقد استخدم العرب هذا الاسم للدلالة على القوة والمنعة

in_urdu.name: راکان
in_urdu.meaning: راکان کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور طاقتور
in_urdu.long_meaning: راکان ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور طاقتور، یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'ر-ک-ن' جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ مضبوطی اور طاقت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا استعمال ایک مضبوط اور مستحکم شخصیت کی علامت کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: राकान
in_hindi.meaning: राकान का अर्थ है मजबूत और शक्तिशाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: राकान एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत और शक्तिशाली, यह नाम अरबी जड़ों 'र-ک-न' से लिया गया है जो कि मजबूती और शक्ति की ओर संकेत करता है, और इस्लामी संस्कृति में इसका उपयोग एक मजबूत और स्थिर व्यक्तित्व के प्रतीक के रूप में किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: رکان
in_pashto.meaning: رکان د قوي او ځواکمن معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: رکان د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د قوي او ځواکمن معنی لري، دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'ر-ک-ن' ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د مضبوطۍ او ځواک نښه کوي، او په اسلامي کلتور کې د يو قوي او مستحکم شخصیت د نښه په توګه کارول کيږي

The name carries spiritual significance, reflecting the virtues of courage and determination

data.cultural_impact: The name Rakan has cultural significance particularly in the Malaysian and Indonesian communities, as it is a name derived from Islamic traditions. In Islam, the term Rakib or Rakan can be found in multiple situations. One such reference is in the brotherhood of Ridwan and Israfel, two angels that assist Allah in the record keeping of human actions. Yet another reference is referenced in the Hadith of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), where he mentions that a person is awarded two rewards whenever they help or assist someone else in fulfilling a good deed. Thus, the name Rakan in a cultural context signifies one who helps, supports, and assists others.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Rakan holds a deep significance. It is mentioned in various Hadiths and Quranic verses that emphasize the importance of helping and supporting others, not only in this world but also in the Hereafter. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, "Whosoever revives an excellent practice from the past, Allah will reward him with part of the reward of the Prophets, and they will have the same standing in Allah's sight as those who introduced it, with nothing decreasing from their reward on Allah's part." (Tirmidhi, Abwab as-Sunnah, 1121). Thus, the name Rakan in a spiritual context signifies one who is a helper and supporter, not just of other human beings but also of Deen and Allah himself, in fulfilling His commands and striving towards a virtuous path.

historical_references.reference: Rakan ibn Abi Barkat was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad who embraced Islam before the Hijra (migration) to Medina. He was among the Ten Promised Paradise and participated in the Battle of Badr.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic history and military campaigns

historical_references.reference: Rakan al-Ghifari was a prominent leader of the Khawarij, a radical sect that emerged during the early Islamic community after the death of Prophet Muhammad. He led the First Fitna (civil war) in 652 AD and was killed at the Battle of Siffin.
historical_references.context: Islamic sectarian conflicts and military campaigns

The use of the name Rakan reflects the importance of companionship and camaraderie in Malay and Indonesian culture.
